about: Each version groups the changes released together, newest first. Version numbers start at v1.0 with the first release.

releases.title: Research
releases.summary: A new Research menu: models and studies tested on seasons they had never seen, then a fresh design for each Research page.

entries.title: Win Probability
entries.text: Live win probability for every game, checked each night against ESPN's.

entries.title: Projected Impact
entries.text: CourtLens's own player rating, with aging curves and 2026-27 projections locked in before the games are played.

entries.title: Lineup Model
entries.text: A lineup tool that rates any five-player lineup, and a map of similar players.

entries.title: RAPM history
entries.text: Twelve seasons of RAPM impact ratings, each with a range showing how certain it is.

entries.title: Six-Factor RAPM
entries.text: Player impact split into shooting, turnovers and rebounding on offense and defense, with an Impact Tree.

entries.title: Metric Backtest
entries.text: Nine impact metrics ranked by how well they predict real game results.

entries.title: zTS
entries.text: True shooting adjusted for how hard each player's shots are.

entries.title: Shot Quality
entries.text: How good each player's shots are, and how much better or worse they make them than expected.

entries.title: Defensive Shot Quality
entries.text: How shooters do against each defender compared with their usual shooting.

entries.title: Signal vs Noise
entries.text: How many attempts each stat needs before it reflects skill, plus a Stats toggle for steadier shooting percentages.

entries.title: Draft Classes
entries.text: What each draft pick returned since 1966, every class redrafted, and this season's rookies against past picks.

entries.title: Wingspan and ORtg Calculator
entries.text: Wingspan beside career defensive impact, and each season's real four-factor numbers in the ORtg calculator.

entries.title: Learning and Patch Notes
entries.text: A guide to advanced stats, from the basics to models, and this list of changes.

entries.title: Research menu
entries.text: Regrouped into Models, Impact, Shooting, and Methods and Tools. Workload Trends, Distributions & Splits and the Blog were removed.

log.heading: 2026-11-05 — Research menu trimmed, dropped pages removed (owner request, part of R12)
